definition: a living animal that can move by itself
description: Filmed from the back of a huge scaled animal, as a rider would see it. The creature is dark red and black with rows of spines down its neck, horns on its head and an amber eye, and it stands on a cliff above a fjord with a leather saddle and harness strapped over its shoulders. It turns its head, then throws itself off the cliff; the shot dives with it down a gorge past a waterfall, skims low over the water between rock walls, and flies on through fog towards a distant spired castle.
